name: Red Hills Lake County

known.via: English Wikipedia "Red Hills Lake County AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Lake County AVA of red, stony soils on rolling hills at the foot of Mount Konocti, beside Clear Lake.
